description: This PHP class defines a form for configuring view UI settings in Drupal, including options for default display, embedded displays, live preview, and SQL query display.

classes.name: BasicSettingsForm
classes.description: Form builder for the admin display defaults page in Drupal's Views UI module.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form with options for display settings and live preview.
